# Second pass over the infrastructure port from indexit

This pass re-checked the uncommitted port ([20260924T170836Z](20260924T170836Z.md) and its reviews) against `octopot/indexit` at `49738e3` and the owner's decisions recorded in the indexit sessions of 2026-09-18…24, both Claude and Codex, and the maintainer Codex session of the first port. Most of the port holds. Three places went against a decision the owner made for indexit, and the documentation still described the port instead of the repository. No commits, stages, pushes, dispatches or remote changes were made.

## Realigned with the owner's decisions

| Area | First port | Decision in indexit | Now |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Go version | Application kept at 1.26, tools at 1.27 | «т.к. это go tool, то он должен поддерживать актуальный стабильный релиз go»: both `go.mod`, `GO_VERSIONS` and every `setup-go` move together | `go 1.27.0`, `GO_VERSIONS = 1.27`, CI/healthcheck/warmup matrices `1.x` + `1.27.x`, docs say Go 1.27; `go mod tidy` changes nothing |
| Git hooks | Copied from `bin/lib/git/hooks` into `.git/hooks`; install refused when `core.hooksPath` is set | «не .githooks, а .github/hooks»: versioned hooks wired by `core.hooksPath` (octomation/makefiles#81; the two mechanisms must not both be active) | Hooks live in `.github/hooks`; `make hooks` sets the local `core.hooksPath`, `make unhook` unsets it; `bin/lib/git/hooks` is gone. The pre-commit lint, the release guard plus `make deps-tidy verify` on pre-push and `make deps` on post-merge are kept |
| `GOPRIVATE` | `go.octolab.net` kept | `go.octolab.org` (octomation/makefiles#78): vanity modules resolve directly, a canary for the domain (indexit#102) | `Makefile` and `bin/activate` use `go.octolab.org`; a direct fetch through `go.octolab.org` succeeds, `release.mjs vanity` passes |

## Smaller corrections

- `cd.yml` keys its Go cache on `tools/go.sum`, as ci `vulns` does: `make tools` dominates the release job, and the app-only key never covered it.
- The post-merge hook runs `make deps` only; reinstalling copies is meaningless with `core.hooksPath`.
- `release.test.mjs` covers the new wiring: the local `core.hooksPath` overrides a global one without touching its files, and `unhook` restores it.
- The vanity comment in `release.mjs` states the `GOPRIVATE` rationale again.

## Documentation

- `.github/workflows/README.md` follows the indexit structure: a table of workflows, one diagram of their relations, common ground with secrets and a generic "Set up GitHub" checklist, then one section per workflow, with the maintainer specifics (healthcheck, Formula and Cask, `ci.yml` in the runs cleanup, the release gates in CI).
- `tools/README.md` lists each tool with its actual consumer and drops the port history.
- `docs/readme.md` is rewritten as a practical guide (run, build, content map, release notes, domain change), as indexit's `docs/README.md`. The stub `docs/changelog.md` is removed: the changelog lives in `docs/content/changelog/`.
- `README.md` and `docs/content/index.mdx` describe the Formula and the coming Cask without references to "the updated workflow".
- The setup link in [20260924T170836Z](20260924T170836Z.md) points to the new section.

## Left as they are, deliberately

- `make lint` keeps `--fast-only`, as the old `fast: true` did. indexit lints fully; here that reports 8 findings in application code (7 staticcheck QF1008, 1 noctx), which the pre-commit hook would then block. Fix them first, then drop the flag.
- No stale-issue workflow: `.github/stale.yml` configures the retired Probot app, and `actions/stale` would start closing the backlog mirrored in `.github/issues`. It needs the owner's decision.
- The release build cache of indexit#105 is not needed: the four targets build in seconds.
- PR builds of the docs take the site URL from `.github/settings.json` rather than from Pages, so they work before Pages is enabled.

## Follow-up after the owner's review

The owner set up the GitHub side before the commit:

- `make hooks` ran in the clone: `core.hooksPath` is `.github/hooks`.
- Pages publishes from GitHub Actions on the custom domain `maintainer.octolab.org`, with an approved certificate; `octomation.github.io/maintainer/` redirects to it. `pages.cname` in `.github/settings.json`, `docs/site.mjs`, the docs guide, the workflows guide and the badge in `README.md` follow the domain. The static export for the domain builds with canonical URLs on it.
- `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` is an organization secret shared with the repository. `make doctor` now reads the organization secrets available to the repository (`repos/{repo}/actions/organization-secrets`), which needs no `admin:org`, and reports it as `ok` instead of `unverified`.
- `bin/manual-install` is deleted.

`make doctor` still fails, as expected before the push, on:

- the seven workflows disabled by hand: enable them after the push;
- Enforce HTTPS, off while `.github/settings.json` wants it on: the certificate is approved, toggle it in Settings → Pages;
- the site, 404 until the first deployment of `docs.yml`.

The organization `octomation` still holds `GORELEASER_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`, `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `DEPENDABOT_TOKEN`, which these workflows do not use, and `SLACK_WEBHOOK`, which every notification will use once the workflows are on. In `octopot`, `GORELEASER_TOKEN`, the Cloudflare pair and `SLACK_WEBHOOK` turned out stale and were deleted.

## Commit review

The port was committed in reviewed steps, one concern per commit. Decisions taken along the way:

- The issue bodies were brought back to intent, as the mirror contract requires; their state moved into the issue review [20260925T042955Z](../reviews/20260925T042955Z.md), and the bodies were published to GitHub.
- The `ignore` block in `go.mod` carries no comments.
- Homebrew: the Formula is deprecated from 2026-11-05 in favour of the Cask, which serves macOS and Linux; retiring it is [#456](https://github.com/octomation/maintainer/issues/456). Homebrew cannot declare a conflict between a formula and a cask, so the Formula has a caveat and the Cask `preflight_steps` warn when the Formula owns the binary link.
- The Cask `preflight_steps` clear the quarantine attribute of the unsigned binary. A `postflight` hook, as the GoReleaser documentation suggests, runs after the completions are generated, which execute the binary; a local install hung on a Gatekeeper prompt there. `hooks` render `preflight`, which Homebrew 7 deprecates, hence a `custom_block`. The same step went to indexit.
- The docs examples print `→`, as the CLI does ([#61](https://github.com/octomation/maintainer/issues/61)).

Next: push, enable the workflows, then follow [Set up GitHub](../workflows/README.md#set-up-github).
